attempts.summary: Created an SSH host CA on node1, signed the ed25519 host key with it, configured sshd to present the certificate, and verified a client trusting only the CA (no pinned host key) connects successfully with StrictHostKeyChecking=yes. Falsified by showing the same client fails without CA trust. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1 via shutdown -r now, confirmed boot_id changed after reconnect, and re-verified sshd health, the host certificate, and CA-trust client connectivity post-restart.
